from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as it appears in the text")
    category: Literal['行政行为-行政许可', '与公司，证券，保险，票据等有关的民事纠纷', '侵犯公民人身权利，民主权利罪', '行政主体-劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）', '行政行为-行政补偿', '执行案由-其他案由'] = Field(description="The case cause classification based on the document content")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo] = Field(description="List of extracted documents with their titles and categories")
